resources.string: When enabled, NoBot can read and capture your screen, tap, swipe, enter text and open apps. Screens and results are sent to your configured server. Configure the connection, manually enable accessibility, then tap Start. Return here to pause at any time.
Phone endpoint URL (HTTPS, or HTTP on a LAN / VPN)
Enter a valid endpoint (HTTPS for public addresses), a 32-character device ID and a 64-character token
Enable the NoBot accessibility service first
Accepting NoBot commands; tap to pause
Authorization revoked or mismatched; pair again
Action timed out; paused. Check the phone screen.
Point at the QR code on the web Pairing page
Server: %1$s\nSaving pauses control; tap Start accepting commands again afterwards.
HTTP is not encrypted. Use it only on a LAN or VPN.
Unsupported code version; update the app
Invalid pairing details; generate new ones on the web page
No pairing link on the clipboard
Wake and unlock when a command arrives with the screen off

Works only without a lock screen password (swipe) or while Smart Lock trusts the phone. With a password the screen stays off and the command reports the phone is locked. A screen woken by the app locks again after 30 idle seconds, unless you use the phone in the meantime.
Wake and unlock: turn the screen on to run commands
Panel off only: run commands with a black screen (needs Shizuku or root)

In panel-off mode, each new task automatically turns the panel off while the system stays awake and unlocked. Screenshots and taps still work; battery use is close to screen-on. Press power to lock, then wake and unlock to release it manually for the rest of this task. The next task applies the mode again. The panel stays off after a task until you release it, pause control, or change modes. A phone locked with a password must be unlocked first.
Shizuku (no root; start via wireless debugging)
Screen panel: off (press power to restore)
Screen panel: failed to turn off; this system may not support it

Not connected to Shizuku. Open Shizuku and check it says it is running. If it is, come back and try again after a few seconds; if that fails, force-stop NoBot Phone Companion in system settings and reopen it (then re-enable accessibility).
Shizuku is too old; update to version 11 or later
Not authorised yet; tap Check permission and allow it in the dialog
No root access, or the root request was denied
Not paired yet. Scan the QR code on the web Pairing page.
Allow autostart and unrestricted power use in system settings
Off; NoBot cannot operate the phone
Exempt; commands keep arriving with the screen off
Not exempt; may disconnect with the screen off
Not allowed; no notice is shown while controlled

Often frozen by the system: allow this app to run in the background without restrictions and auto-start, and lock it in recent apps. Could not reach the server: check whether EasyTier or your VPN is also being stopped by power saving.

You have %1$s. Updating restarts the app; control pauses for a few seconds and then resumes, and accessibility and other permissions are kept. Please update the Phone Control extension on your server too.
Installing, please confirm in the system dialog
Allow this app to install apps, then come back and tap again
Could not reach GitHub (%1$s). Check your network or proxy and retry
The %1$s release is missing the APK or checksum file
The downloaded file failed verification and was deleted. Please retry
The downloaded package is not a newer version of this app and was deleted

Privileged mode uses Shizuku for touch, keys, screenshots, app launching and waking. Start and authorize Shizuku first. Keep accessibility enabled for connection and status management. Text input requires an accessible editable field. Panel-off uses Shizuku; the original Root setting is retained for accessibility mode. Switching pauses control; permission loss never silently falls back or replays actions.
Control method changed and paused. Start control again.
Privileged service unavailable. Check Shizuku or stop other phone automation tools.
Pause control before checking the privileged service
Checking the privileged service, please wait
Dedicated mode: resume control after restarts

When on, if the app or phone restarts or the accessibility service reconnects, control resumes automatically as long as you last tapped Start. Use it for a phone left alone for the character. In high-privilege mode Shizuku still has to be started again after a reboot.

Notifications (app name, title and text) are sent to your server over the connection, so the character can notice new messages and decide whether to check or reply. Ongoing notifications and this app\'s own are not sent. Turning this off clears unsent notifications.
